input.summary: Extend the Services licence in 13.1 to Affiliates and contractors and remove Vendor's at-will revocation and the non-transferability bar.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a Services licence granted to Meridian alone that Copperleaf may revoke at will, so we have extended the grant to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf and tied revocation to the uncured material breach standard already in Section 13.3 (which also preserves our transfer rights to an Affiliate or successor).

ops.oldText: Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
ops.newText: Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on Customer's behalf a licence to use the Services, revocable only as provided in Section 13.3.
